claim: La Table du Castellet is located at the Hôtel & Spa du Castellet, 3001 Route des Hauts du Camp, 83330 Le Castellet.
quote: Address: 3001 Route des Hauts du Camp, 83330 Le Castellet. Nestled in a natural setting between the Sainte-Baume mountains and the Var coastline.

claim: La Table du Castellet holds three Michelin stars, awarded in March 2024 and retained in the 2026 guide.
quote: La Table du Castellet — Three MICHELIN Stars. Executive Chef Fabien Ferré offers a cuisine as delicate as it is flavorful, combining technical precision with emotion.

claim: Hôtel & Spa du Castellet is a 5-star Relais & Châteaux with 43 rooms and suites in ochre-toned Tuscan-influenced buildings on a 12-hectare umbrella-pine park at 430 m elevation, with a 700 m² spa.
quote: 43 rooms and suites across ochre-toned buildings with Tuscan architectural influences ... 12-hectare natural park surrounded by umbrella pines ... 700m² spa with natural light and outdoor spaces.

claim: Hôtel & Spa du Castellet shows TripAdvisor price ranges of $303–$939 per night and a 4.6/5 rating from 926 reviews, with mixed signals on dated room décor against strong grounds and service.
quote: The hotel's price range is $303–$939 per night for standard rooms ... 4.6/5 rating from 926 reviews ... some note dated décor, but service and grounds get strong marks.

claim: Maison Bérard (La Cadière-d'Azur) is a 4-star family-run village hotel with 32 unique Provençal-restored rooms, the Riva restaurant, and a 500 m² AromaSpa, part of the Teritoria mission-driven community.
quote: 32 unique guest rooms and suites ... modernized while maintaining authentic Provençal character ... a family philosophy where hospitality is an art ... part of Teritoria.

claim: Maison Bérard is spread across four village buildings (main house, Les Peintres, Le Couvent, La Bastide); guest reviews are mixed, with room quality varying meaningfully by building.
quote: The hotel consists of four individual houses - the main building where the gastronomic restaurant is located, Les Peintres and Le Couvent 2-3 doors away and La Bastide in the parallel street.

claim: Hostellerie de l'Abbaye de la Celle is a 5-star, 10-room 18th-century inn beside the Abbey of La Celle, transformed by Alain Ducasse in 1999, on 2.5 hectares of vineyards and olive groves.
quote: charming 18th-century inn that was transformed by renowned chef Alain Ducasse in 1999 ... 10 refined rooms and suites ... 2.5 hectares of private grounds.

claim: La Celle is 48.9 km / about 49 minutes by car from Le Castellet — at the outer edge of practical late-night taxi range.
quote: The road distance is 48.9 km ... It takes approximately 49 min to drive from La Celle to Le Castellet.

claim: Île Rousse Thalazur Bandol is a 5-star seafront hotel with 55 rooms + 12 suites on Renécros Bay, an infinity pool of heated sea water, two private beaches, and a 100 m² thalasso area (32°C indoor seawater pool, hammam, hydromassage).
quote: The 5-star establishment houses 55 rooms and 12 spacious suites ... 100 m² marine area including an indoor seawater pool heated to 32°C ... two private beaches.

claim: Les Roches Blanches Cassis is an 1887 mansion converted to a hotel in the early 1920s, perched between the village and the Calanques with Cap Canaille views; past guests include Churchill and Piaf. Sisley Spa; four dining venues; Michelin 2 keys 2025.
quote: built in 1887 close to the sea ... hosted notable guests including Winston Churchill and Edith Piaf ... Michelin recognition (2 keys, 2025).

claim: Cassis is about 25.6 km / 21 minutes from Le Castellet by car; taxi $70–$90.
quote: Taxi costs $70-$90 and takes 21 minutes, with a road distance of 15.9 miles (approximately 25.6 km).

claim: La Maison du Castellet is a small residence in the Bandol vineyards with 5 independent guest rooms (private terraces), a pool, sauna, gym, run by hosts Nafissa and Sébastien.
quote: 5 independent guest rooms with private terraces, set in lush, quiet vegetation ... swimming pool, gym, sauna ... run by Nafissa and Sébastien.

claim: Bastide de Fontvieille is a 4-suite chambres d'hôtes in an 18th-century former wine bastide in Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer with a 3,200 m² garden; hosts Stéphanie and Éric; ranked #1 of 6 B&Bs in Saint-Cyr on TripAdvisor.
quote: eighteenth century bastide is a former wine producing estate lined with cypress, plane, olive and fruit trees ... 4 charming suites and guest rooms ... ranked n°1 out of 6 bed and breakfasts.

claim: Bandol to Le Castellet is 10.3 km / about 15 minutes by car, taxi $30–$40.
quote: Taxi takes 15 minutes and costs $30-$40, with a road distance of 6.4 miles (approximately 10.3 km).

claim: Le Castellet has no permanent taxi stand at the hillside village; pre-booking a Var VTC by phone is the standard pattern for evening pickups.
quote: Le Castellet is a hillside tourist village without always having taxis available on-site; you generally need to call directly to a taxi company or central dispatch in the region.

claim: Taxi Bandol advertises 24/7 service including night-time drop-and-return runs for evening venues — the same service shape needed for a late dinner.
quote: Taxi Bandol officiel disponible 24h7j ... Taxi Bandol Gérald is available to drop off and later pick up passengers for nightlife.

claim: Grand Hôtel des Bains in Sanary-sur-Mer is a Belle-Époque property dating to 1890, set in a 3,000 m² park a 2-minute walk from the nearest beach, with a recent renovation.
quote: Grand Hôtel des Bains is set in a 3,000 m² park in Sanary-sur-Mer, with its history dating back to 1890 and its recent renovation giving it a unique charm.
